title: Iron Man — Built in a cave

hook.context: Matbuot anjumanida Tony Stark tayyorlangan matnni o'qish o'rniga sir saqlamay, haqiqatni ochiq aytadi. "I am" — qisqartirilmagan, urg'u bilan aytilgan shakl, qat'iylik bildiradi.

reading: Tony Stark is a genius and a billionaire. His company makes weapons, and they are sold to the army all over the world.
During a weapons test in Afghanistan, Tony is attacked and kidnapped by terrorists. A piece of metal has been left near his heart, and he is kept alive by a magnet.
The terrorists want him to build a powerful missile. Instead, Tony and another prisoner, Yinsen, secretly build an armoured suit. The suit is made from old weapon parts in a dark cave.
Tony escapes, but Yinsen is killed. Tony is shocked when he discovers that his own weapons are being used by the terrorists.
Back home, he announces that his company will no longer produce weapons. The board of directors is not happy, especially his partner Obadiah Stane.
In his workshop, a new, much better suit is designed and built. Tony tests it again and again until he can fly.
Later Tony learns that the attack was planned by Stane himself. The two men fight, and the city is saved. At a press conference, Tony tells the world his secret.

grammar.title: Passive Voice: is made, was built
explain: **Passive** — harakatni KIM qilgani emas, harakatning O'ZI yoki obyekti muhim bo'lganda: The suit **is made** from old parts. Shakl: **be + V3**.
Zamon **be** orqali o'zgaradi: is made (hozir), **was** built (o'tmish), **has been** left (Present Perfect), **will be** sold (kelasi), **is being** used (davomli).
Bajaruvchi kerak bo'lsa — **by**: The attack was planned **by** Stane. Muhim bo'lmasa, tushirib qoldiriladi: Tony was kidnapped.
Active → Passive: Terrorists use his weapons → His weapons **are used** by terrorists. Obyekt egaga aylanadi.
